title: Lock screen
brief: Decent hyprlock lock screen for the sky Hyprland setup: wallpaper-driven colors from sky_theme.py, clock, date, user, password field with wrong-password and Caps Lock states, keyboard layout, system status and now-playing. Every element must be buildable with hyprlock (background, label, shape, image, input-field).

artboards.title: Centered stack
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar and balanced; blurred wallpaper loses the scene, status pushed to the corners

artboards.title: Editorial corner
artboards.tradeoff: Sharp wallpaper stays the hero and the clock has character; input off-center is less obvious on the second monitor

artboards.title: Glass card
artboards.tradeoff: Everything grouped in one readable panel on any wallpaper; heavier, more 'widget' than ambient
